sloka: एतदेव वचः श्रुत्वा भरतो भ्रातृवत्सलः ।धर्मात्मा सहशत्रुघ्नः कथं शक्ष्यति जीवितुम् ।। 5.55.19 ।।।।
transliteration: etadeva vacaḥ śrutvā bharato bhrātṛvatsalaḥ ।dharmātmā sahaśatrughnaḥ kathaṁ śakṣyati jīvitum ।। 5.55.19 ।।।।

translations.english: 'When the righteous Ikshvaku race perishes the people would be tormented by grief and remorse. There is no doubt.
